title: Spot the confounder

choices: Age, because all studies have age effects
Coffee, because the association is strong
Smoking, because coffee drinkers were more likely to smoke
explanations: Possible, but the known confounder is smoking.

hints: Is there a third variable that affects both?
Think about what else differs between the groups.
solution: The association is explained by a third variable: smoking, because coffee drinkers were more likely to smoke.
